resources.string: Looking for screens on this Wi-Fi…

None found yet. Check that:
• the screen is on and showing the clock
• this phone is on the same Wi-Fi (not a guest network)
• any VPN on this phone is off
Or type the screen's address below.
Tip: the address is shown in the Pi\'s log and in your router\'s list of devices. It\'s the Pi\'s name or IP address; port 8080 is added for you.
